title: 语义字场动作接力｜成年角色每次行动生成一个空间短词
source_title: 墨字霓虹东京｜汉字动作与赛博街景同步
summary: 同一明确成年角色在连续空间里完成动作，每个动作只生成一个与行为或心理相关的巨大短词；文字成为可穿越、遮挡或反射的环境结构，最终回到同一身份终局。
input_format: Establish one clearly adult original subject, three identity anchors and one continuous world axis. + Bind each decisive action to exactly one short original semantic word that appears only after the action begins. + Make each word occupy, divide, reflect or redirect the physical environment rather than float as a subtitle. + Escalate typography scale and spatial depth while preserving identity, travel direction and readable action. + Return to the same adult face or full-body anchor and resolve the word sequence into one terminal identity proof.
recommended_input: 原创雨夜船坞中，锁定一名明确成年铜发路线工程师，穿深蓝长外套、持黄铜测量杆，沿固定左右方向移动。；她穿门奔跑、转动绞盘并跨过栈桥；准确短词【TURN】和【CROSS】分别从绞盘辐条与桥栏生成，每个动作只对应一个词。；回到雨水玻璃中的脸部倒影；之前字构在她身后对齐，只让准确终局词【CHOOSE】与同一成年肖像锁定。
required_anchors: Establish one clearly adult original subject, three identity anchors and one continuous world axis.
Bind each decisive action to exactly one short original semantic word that appears only after the action begins.
Escalate typography scale and spatial depth while preserving identity, travel direction and readable action.
Return to the same adult face or full-body anchor and resolve the word sequence into one terminal identity proof.
